value.rationale: The natural integral symmetric-group homology structure, not determined by the historically established wedge rank, gives an irreducible hook representation over Q and a cycle-type character for every permutation and every n≥4. The explicit equivariant star collapse and augmentation contraction give a structural description and concrete integral basis, useful in equivariant topological combinatorics; not an arbitrary finite slice or recomputation of known Betti numbers.
